Changing trolley to hand carrier preserves the connection, while withholding transfer changes P1 output. Thirteen required inspection minutes leave no inspection-idling margin. The present connection generating B9 missing contents conflicts with the stipulated initial discrepancy. Disabling either parent or measuring its ordinary output alone defeats this recipe.

Ledger comparison predicts nine source unloads, twelve correct releases, and thirteen inspection minutes for both; transfer occupation is seven versus nine minutes without blocked unloading. This feasible comparison checks timing and actor burden, but cannot attribute B9 mismatch to the connection.

residue.text: Retain B9 discrepancy under either vehicle schedule. Count nine, add the supplied spare, recount ten, and seal over two minutes. Its completed correct release occurs at 10 in the calculated benchmarks; a matching packing mark is insufficient.

Packing-discrepancy cause remains unknown. Later request adaptation is unobserved and changes no present demand. These are finite-model calculations, not observed trials or evidence of future performance. A lawful intervention preserving both parent functions while severing only their connection remains unavailable; therefore the required causal attribution is not established.
